scope.flow: PrecompileReader.suppliedBalance() reads 0x811 supplied balance, MonetrixAccountant._readL1Backing() accumulates it into totalBackingSigned(), and settle() distributes inflated surplus as yield
scope.environment: Hyperliquid PM-enabled protocol with 0x811 precompile, MonetrixAccountant, Vault, YieldEscrow, Operator settlement

statements.text: Governor enables PM via setPmEnabled(true), an expected governance operation.
Once PM is enabled, the Vault automatically registers 0x811 supplied slots in the Accountant when executing hedges and BLP operations through executeHedge() and supplyToBlp().
After PM is enabled, the Hyperliquid PM engine automatically manages the Vault's L1 account borrowing based on market conditions, requiring no attacker to trigger.
The Vault supplies 500,000 USDC and 200,000 USDC is auto-borrowed, so the net value should be 300,000 USDC.
The Operator calls settle(proposedYield) as part of normal duties.
settle() transfers real EVM USDC into YieldEscrow.
The Operator distributes the yield via distributeYield() to sUSDM holders, InsuranceFund, and Foundation.

PrecompileReader.suppliedBalance() only extracts the fourth field (supply.value) when decoding the 0x811 BorrowLendUserTokenState struct, completely discarding the borrow.basis and borrow.value fields.
MonetrixAccountant._readL1Backing() accumulates supply values into total via suppliedUsdcEvm() or suppliedNotionalUsdcFromPerp() without ever subtracting borrow values.
totalBackingSigned() is permanently inflated: with 500,000 USDC supplied and 200,000 USDC auto-borrowed, the Accountant counts the full 500,000 USDC instead of the net 300,000 USDC.
Because distributableSurplus includes 200,000 USDC of phantom surplus, Gate 3 does not block the yield distribution that should not have passed.
Real USDC is extracted from the protocol each settlement cycle as phantom yield, cumulatively eroding protocol solvency.
With 10M USDM supply, each 21-hour settlement cycle extracts approximately 6,904 USDC of phantom yield, accumulating to roughly 234,000 USDC over 30 days across approximately 34 settlement cycles.

Inferred: totalBackingSigned() must reflect net L1 backing (supply minus borrow), so that distributableSurplus and Gate 3 only permit yield distributions backed by real net assets, preserving the INV-1 solvency invariant (backing >= totalSupply).
No step in the chain requires malicious behavior or unreasonable assumptions; PM enablement, auto-borrow, and Operator settle() are normal protocol operations.

ambiguities: Report does not establish that PM was actually enabled or that auto-borrow occurred in a real transaction; scenario is conditional on planned governance operation.
The 500,000/200,000 USDC figures are a hypothetical illustration ('suppose'), not observed on-chain values.
No explicit statement that anyone can call settle(); Operator is described as acting in normal duties.
Timing of borrow relative to settlement cycle is not specified beyond 'after PM is enabled'.
Whether the borrow persists or grows is stated as conditional ('If the borrow persists or grows').
